allCommands: SELECT id, name, description, category, perms, enabled FROM collectCommands WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY name ASC
allQuotes: SELECT id, text, speaker, game, date, favorite FROM collectQuotes ORDER BY id ASC
randomQuote: SELECT text FROM collectQuotes ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 1
quoteById: SELECT text FROM collectQuotes WHERE id = ? LIMIT 1
searchQuoteByText: SELECT text FROM collectQuotes WHERE text LIKE ? LIMIT 1
